capture_source: Live RFC_READ_TABLE on a NetWeaver 7.52 ABAP Developer Edition (NPL), kernel release 753 patch 16, captured by the reporter of issue #44 against fix/44-multiframe-compressed-table (commit 263f950) and contributed as the exact failing stream. Seven server->client GW frames (type 0x06cb) in call order: six of 28080 bytes (28000-byte payloads, the gateway's ~28000-byte chunk size) and a 2786-byte tail. The compressed DATA table spans all seven frames, and the frame boundaries fall between fixed-width 0x0305 records, which is what the unpatched tlv_stream_status mis-classified as not_tlv. Credential-scrubbed by the reporter and re-verified here (ASCII + UTF-16LE grep for password/sapsa/SSFS/secstore markers: none). Reply direction server->client only.
evidence: The exact reproduction of issue #44. Unpatched (0.1.5/0.1.6) the reader stops after frame 0 -- frame 0's body classifies not_tlv on the old rule -- hands the decompressor a truncated stream, and raises 'SAPCOMPRESS decompression failed ... unexpected end of compressed data', poisoning the connection. With the fix the seven bodies join to a complete 170706-byte TLV stream (see expected_parse) and the DATA table decompresses to the full 10000 rows. Confirmed live by the reporter (7 frames, 171266 bytes, 10000 rows) and offline here.

expected_parse.note: Per-frame body status under the fix: frames 0,1,3,4,5 'truncated' (continuation ending on a 0x0305 record boundary), frames 2 and 6 'not_tlv' standalone; only the joined stream is a complete TLV. Final frame (06) carries offset60=1; frames 00-05 carry offset60=0.
